title: Picker max_tokens raise: 1024 → 4096 to eliminate truncated-response retry class
goal: Empirical Phase 3 validation on 2026-05-17 surfaced that the picker's `max_tokens=1024` is too small for long `level_up` decisions that include a multi-step `plan` body. The response gets truncated mid-string, which is grammatically invalid (so Anthropic structured outputs from #330 cannot reject server-side) and lands on the `_tolerant_json_fix` deprecated fallback warning. `_call_picker_with_retries` (#331) catches it on a second attempt — but the right fix is to give the picker enough output budget that it doesn't need to retry.
scope: Modify the `client.messages.create(...max_tokens=1024)` call in `_claude_select_next_action` (api/app/services/assessment_loop.py) to use a larger limit (4096) that comfortably fits a multi-step plan body + reasoning text. Verify in unit tests that the schema still accepts and that the larger limit doesn't break any existing test fixture.
generation_reason: Captured live in /tmp/aegispt-api.log on 2026-05-17 during the Phase 3 checkpoint validation: picker output=1024 tokens exactly = response cut off mid-string at char 927. `_call_picker_with_retries` from #331 saved the loop, but this should not be a regular event — it wastes a Claude call per truncation. The retry mechanism is for transient cases, not predictable budget overruns. See docs/checkpoints/2026-mythos-phase3-review.md §4.2 + §4 follow-up.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement until this package is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Single literal change to max_tokens. Do NOT change the schema, the retry wrapper, the system prompt, or anything else.
constraints.cache_friendly: max_tokens does not affect prompt caching (it's an output budget, not part of the cached prefix). Confirm via a test that prompt-cache behavior is unchanged.

success_criteria: All existing Phase 3 tests (test_assessment_loop_structured_outputs.py + test_assessment_loop_soft_retry.py) still pass.
After deployment, `picker recovered after N retry(ies)` log lines from THIS class disappear (verifiable post-deploy with `scripts/_phase3_checkpoint_mine.py`).

acceptance_criteria: No new lint or compile errors.
